ModMetaData.name: Construction Pipeline Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces redundant work selection and validation in the zero-cost construction pipeline used by Tilled Soil and similar terrain.
The optimization asks the active construction work giver to continue a completed no-cost frame into its approved FinishFrame job, distributes repeated defensive validation over a deterministic cadence where that vanilla hook exists, and preserves a final authorization check immediately before completion.
No settings or save data. Safe to add or remove between saves. For Multiplayer, every peer must use the same version and load order.
Do not enable this with Construction Queue Optimizer; that legacy package contains the same construction patches.
